The record describes occasional or incidental observation, not monitoring that is organized, ongoing, or targeted at particular employees. The Comune di Bolzano decision follows the WP29's own definition of "systematic monitoring" — processing that occurs according to a system, that is pre-arranged or methodical, or that is part of a general plan or strategy. Neither the decision nor that definition addresses monitoring that lacks this organized character. Section 1's determination on this trigger therefore rests on the separately identified facts and rules, not on this decision. (Garante, Comune di Bolzano, decision of 13 May 2021; supervisory-authority decision — persuasive, non-binding outside its jurisdiction.)
